meta.producto: Small blue plastic components being assembled with screws.
meta.operacion: Left hand fetches a workpiece and holds it at the work point; right hand fetches a screw and fastens it using the electric screwdriver.
meta.lugar: Supply areas: blue bins on the left. Work point: center cardboard mat. Output: green conveyor belt on the right.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the bottom. Left hand (Cyan) appears on the left/center; right hand (Magenta) appears on the right/center.
meta.title_en: Screw assembly with a suspended power screwdriver (factory video, CC BY 4.0)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B on AMD GPUs (AMD Token Factory, shared endpoint)
meta.licencia_en: Video: Factory Manipulation Videos by Procedural Robotics Inc. (huggingface.co/datasets/procedural-robotics/factory-manipulation-videos), CC BY 4.0. Excerpt 60-210 s of screw_assembly_station12_worker003.mp4, re-encoded; chart computed by Gilbreth.
